reviews.text: me encantaron estos probióticos de verdad ayudan a la digestión de los alimentos y lo mejor es que parece que comes pequeños caramelos sabor manzana verde. son faciles de transportar y comer en cualquier lugar
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢啲益生菌，真係幫助消化食物，最好係好似食緊啲青蘋果味嘅小糖果咁。方便攜帶，邊度都可以食。

reviews.text: this is an easier way to comsume acv. more addictive i would say. tastes soo good and i could just munch on.
reviews.zh: 呢個係一個更容易攝取 ACV（蘋果醋）嘅方法。我會話更容易令人上癮。味道好好，我可以一路咬一路食。

reviews.text: con esto no me da hambre de cosas dulces eso es lo bueno por lo menos si me ayuda a controlar ese detall de baje de peso pues no he subido pero tampoc he bajado
reviews.zh: 用咗呢款，我唔會想食甜嘢，呢個係好處，至少對控制我減重嘅細節有幫助。我冇增重，但都冇減重。

reviews.text: Tomo vinagre en las mañanas y ha sido efectivo para regular mi tránsito intestinal y en esta presentación es muy cómodo llevarlo a todos lados
reviews.zh: 我每朝飲醋，對調節我嘅腸道運作好有效，而呢個包裝形式攜帶去任何地方都好方便。

reviews.text: It tastes fine, like sour apple candies. I’m not sure whether it has any effect on blood sugar spikes or on fatigue.
reviews.zh: 味道幾好，似酸蘋果糖。我唔肯定佢對血糖飆升或者疲勞有冇效果。

reviews.text: So sweet like candy with apple cider vinegar also nice in small pacgage...good for Great body and digestion ...love
reviews.zh: 好甜，似糖果，有蘋果醋，喺細包裝入面都幾好……對身體同消化都好……好鍾意

reviews.text:
Thus crunchy apple vinegar supplement looks like candy, making it easy to take.
Love to use it when I've been eating out and feel bloated as I feel it helps with digestion.
Will definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh:
呢款脆口嘅蘋果醋補充劑睇落好似糖果，所以好容易食。
每次食完外出飲咗好多野覺得肚脹嗰陣，我都會食，因為我覺得佢有助消化。
一定會再買。

reviews.text: The taste is good and it’s fun to eat but this product is not for me unfortunately.
reviews.zh: 味道好好，食落幾好玩，不過呢款唔啱我，好可惜。
